title: TOTAL waste of money.
text: TOTAL waste of money.. Very difficult to attach power cord to the pan, the heating element only works on ONE setting, that being full out HOT on the dial.  If I moved it to a lower power, it just shuts down.  Lastly, the painted-on inner nonstick surface bubbled and burnt off during my third time using this.  I did love the size of the unit, just wish it was made better.  On its way to the landfill now, I can't even bring myself to donate it to Goodwill.

product_metadata.title: Elite Gourmet EFS-400 Personal Stir Fry Griddle Pan, Rapid Heat Up, 600 Watts Non-stick Electric Skillet with Tempered Glass Lid, Size 7" x 7"
features: COMPACT & PORTABLE: Small compact size (6.75" x 6.75") perfect for small personal servings with a 32 oz. capacity. Ideal for small kitchens, camping or recreational vehicles.
ADJUSTABLE TEMPERATURE: Easily control your cooking or warming of food with the temperature dial.
REMOVABLE LOCKING HANDLE: The clip-on handle easily unlocks from the heating pan for easy cleaning and storage.
GLASS LID: The tempered glass lid with cool-touch knob prevents cooking platters or assists in keeping food warm.
NONSTICK: The Non-stick cooking surface is easy to clean and prevents food sticking while cooking.
FAST & EASY: Cook eggs, bacon, sausage, grilled cheese sandwiches, and a variety of other foods
description: The Elite Cuisine 6.75” Electric Skillet is small and compact making it the perfect appliance to bring on camping trips, RV road trips, or for preparing small servings and solitary meals. Skillet has a 32 ounce capacity with non-stick cooking surface for easy cleaning. There is a removable locking handle and tempered glass lid with cool-touch knob. Adjustable temperature control for cooking versatility. After cooking, remove the handle from the skillet and clean-up is quick and easy. This mini skillet has all the features of larger skillets but its convenient small size is perfect for scrambling eggs, frying bacon, or making mini pancakes.
